attchmntText: Hindprakash Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Hindprakash Industries Limited has published its standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The announcement was made on November 8, 2026. The company placed advertisements in The Indian Express English Edition and Jay Hind Gujarati Edition. The publication includes a Quick Response code and a weblink to access the complete financial results. The information is also available on the company website at www.hindprakash.in. It is accessible on the BSE website at https://www.bseindia.com/ and the NSE website at https://www.nseindia.com/. The filing was signed by Sanjay Prakash Mangal, Managing Director, with DIN 02825484.
